douen: The spirit of a small child with a COMPLETELY BLANK SMOOTH FACE - no eyes, no nose, no mouth - under a WIDE STRAW HAT, in a plain smock, STANDING IN FULL SIDE PROFILE so both bare feet are seen edge-on. THE FEET ARE ATTACHED THE WRONG WAY ROUND: the HEELS point FORWARD in the direction the child faces and the TOES point BACKWARDS behind, each foot plainly reversed at the ankle, isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
